lang.name: English
meta.title: ALive Analysis: pivots, charts and KPIs inside Business Central
meta.description: Analyse your Business Central data where it lives: pivots, charts, KPIs and spreadsheets on a page inside Business Central, with 46 ready templates, your BC permissions and nothing copied out.
hero.title: Your BC data, analysed where it lives.
hero.lead: Pivots, charts, KPIs and spreadsheets on a page inside Business Central: nothing to install outside it, nothing copied out of it, and no second security model.
hero.free: Free plan: every template, for every user.
hero.shot: The CEO dashboard template, running on the CRONUS demo company.
pain.label: Sound familiar?
pain.quote1: Your figures live in Business Central.
pain.quote2: Your analysis lives in yesterday's Excel export.
pain.1.text: Every run reads today's postings. Nothing to refresh, nothing to paste.
pain.2.text: No gateway, no data warehouse, no separate portal or sign-in to keep running.
pain.3.text: Each user sees what Business Central lets them see, and nothing more.
how.title: Three steps to your first workspace
how.sub: A Business Central administrator sets it up. There is no separate platform to install.
how.1.title: Install the extension
how.1.text: From Microsoft AppSource, like any other Business Central app.
how.2.title: Pick a template
how.2.text: Start from one of the 46 templates, or design your own in the Workspace Studio.
how.3.title: Share it with your team
how.3.text: Grant each workspace to the permission sets that should see it.
feat.title: It speaks Business Central
feat.sub: Built for Business Central data, so what you see matches what BC posts and prints.
feat.1.title: Drill down to the record
feat.1.text: From any figure to the Business Central page and records behind it.
feat.2.title: Open in context
feat.2.text: Open a workspace from a customer, vendor, item or G/L account card, already filtered to that record.
feat.3.title: Your reports as sources
feat.3.text: Visual queries over BC tables, your existing BC reports, and financial reports calculated by BC's own engine.
feat.5.title: What a BI user expects
feat.5.text: Pivots, charts, KPI tiles with targets, slicers, a spreadsheet view with formulas, and export to Excel and CSV.
sheet.title: A spreadsheet inside the workspace
sheet.lead: The Sheet view puts worksheets of formulas next to the pivots and charts, reading the workspace's live data.
sheet.list: Formulas read every dataset of the workspace directly: DATASET.SUM, DATASET.LOOKUP, DATASET.ROWS and more.|Nothing to paste or refresh: every run fills the formulas with today's figures.|Familiar spreadsheet editing, number formats and formulas, inside Business Central.|Three templates already include one, on the Free plan: Financial ratios, Sales scorecard and Working capital.
sheet.shot: A Sheet view: formulas over the workspace's datasets.
ext.title: Your extensions' tables and fields, too
ext.lead: Most companies run Business Central with apps and customizations. ALive Analysis sees their tables and fields like the standard ones.
ext.list: Tables and fields that other extensions add, from AppSource apps or your own, appear in the Query Designer next to the standard ones.|Join them, filter them and total them like any other table.|Tables and fields an extension marks as internal are never offered: the extension keeps its own privacy decision.|Design and preview such a query on the Free plan; run your own workspaces with them on Pro.
ext.shot: The Query Designer with a table from another extension.
scripts.title: When a query is not enough, a script
scripts.lead: A dataset can also be a script written in AL syntax, the language of Business Central developers, for logic a visual query cannot express.
scripts.list: AL syntax with IntelliSense, run against your live data from the Studio.|Read-only and sandboxed: a workspace script cannot write data, post, commit or run codeunits.|Nine templates already use scripts, on the Free plan; write your own on Pro.
scripts.shot: A script dataset in the Studio's editor.
vid.slice: Click a value: every chart, the treemap and the pivot follow it.
vid.drill: From a figure in a pivot to the rows behind it, then on to the Business Central record.
vid.context: A workspace opened from a customer card, already filtered to that customer.

tpl.sub: Every template runs on your own data the day you install it, on the Free plan. An automated test compares their figures with the Business Central ledgers. Every template comes in English and Spanish.

roles.admin.title: For the administrator
roles.admin.list: Design visually in the Workspace Studio: queries over BC tables with joins, FlowFields and dimensions, your BC reports and financial reports, or a read-only script.|Grant each workspace to permission sets. There is no second user list.|Let users schedule their own snapshots from the job queue, so heavy workspaces open at once.|Open workspaces from customer, vendor, item and other cards, filtered to that record.
roles.shot: The Workspace Studio: datasets, the Query Designer and views.
sec.title: Your data stays in Business Central
sec.lead: ALive Analysis is an extension inside Business Central, not a service beside it. There is nowhere else for your data to go.
sec.list: Rows go from the Business Central server to the user's page and nowhere else. There is no copy in another cloud.|Every run reads with the user's own Business Central permissions; each workspace is granted to permission sets.|Tables and fields an extension marks as internal are never offered.|Read-only by design: the analysis has no code path that writes business data.|Business Central telemetry holds counts and durations only, never a value, a filter or a name.|ALive Analysis makes no calls of its own to any server.|A file leaves only when a user exports it to Excel or CSV, under Business Central's own export permission.|The optional AI assistant receives definitions only, never a figure.
sec.more: Permissions and access in the documentation
ai.title: An assistant that never sees your figures
ai.lead: ALive AI is a separate, optional app. Describe the analysis you need and it designs the workspace. It can also improve or explain a workspace and suggest views.
ai.list: It works from metadata only: table and field definitions, never a row that a query, report or script returns.|Values inside an existing workspace or script are hidden behind placeholders before it is sent, unless you choose to send a script as written.|Your administrator chooses the AI provider and uses the company's own key, with monthly caps.|Every request is in a log you can read. A designed workspace opens unsaved, for a person to review.
ai.shot: The request log shows what was sent: definitions, no figures.
prices.title: Prices
prices.sub: Per user, per month, through Microsoft AppSource. Start free, and stay free if the templates are all you need.
